subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and re-register `ai.openclaw.mac` after update/startup drift when launchd state no longer matches that intent?
rationale: Current code treats live launchd state as the toggle source of truth, while the report asks for user intent to survive app replacement/update; that choice affects upgrade behavior and user control.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
options.body: Store the user's in-app enabled intent and re-register only the app-owned LaunchAgent when startup or update checks detect drift, with guards for explicit external disablement.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Treat macOS launchd/System Settings state as the only source of truth and adjust UI or diagnostics so OpenClaw does not restore an externally disabled login item.

options.title: Wait for live update proof
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a packaged Sparkle update repro identifies exactly which state changes before choosing a repair path.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
recommendation.body: Store the user's in-app enabled intent and re-register only the app-owned LaunchAgent when startup or update checks detect drift, with guards for explicit external disablement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across the app LaunchAgent path and the launchd-backed toggle behavior.
